children.title: Register `swc-workload-mcp` server config (project‑level, mirrors plugin install)
Update `setup-permissions` to allowlist `mcp__swc-workload__*` alongside `Skill(swc:*)`
Update `docs/usage.md` setup section — add MCP install step pointing at MCP repo instructions
Add `swc:mcp-check` skill — reusable dependency check (silent on success, delegates to guide on miss)
Add `swc:mcp-install` skill — placeholder guide for missing MCP (prompts user; install instructions deferred)
Wire `mcp-check` into `context-init` and front‑line workflow skills (`workflowPlan`, `workflowDeliver`, `report`, `ship`)
Delete `skills/workload/` (including `workload.py`)
Delete `skills/workload-update/`
Delete `skills/workload_item-start/`
Delete `skills/context--workload/`
Drop the `workload.md` stub block from the skill steps
Add MCP `init` invocation against the resolved folder
Confirm the other five stubs (plan/architecture/notes/changelog/pipeline) still scaffold correctly
Replace `workload.md` display strings with structured `Found context {...}` output
Populate `workload: exists/missing` field via MCP `exists` call
Update multi‑folder case to list candidates with workload status per row
Fix misleading "No workload found under .swc/" → "No context found under .swc/" (plus adjacent "No matching workload" → "No matching context" for consistency)

Back `context-lookup` with a Python helper (`context-lookup.py`) — single-call probe replaces 5–7 model-driven tool calls on the happy path; interactive cases and the single MCP `exists` call remain in the skill
`workflowPlan_context` — use MCP `exists` for existing‑workload detection
`workflowPlan_delivery` — use MCP `add` to write skeleton items
`workflowPlan_breakdown` — use MCP `add` for full breakdown, MCP `list` for playback
`workflowDeliver` — use MCP `find`/`get`/`list(status=in-progress)`/`set_status(in-progress)`/`add` (for untracked work)
`workflowDeliver_requirements` — use MCP `get` for item entry
`workflowDeliver_implement` — use MCP `get` for agent brief
`workflowDeliver_refine` — use MCP `get`
`workflowDeliver_review` — use MCP `get`
`workflowDeliver_accept` — use MCP `set_status(done)`
`workflowImplement_orient` — use MCP `get` and `set_status(in-progress)`
`report` — use MCP `list` for render, MCP next‑not‑started for NEXT STEP
`ship` — use MCP `list` to match changes → items, MCP `set_status` for updates
Re-add `/swc:workload` skill — wraps `context-lookup` + MCP `list` for the user-facing "list workitems" prompt (refactored replacement for the skill deleted in item 2.1)

Terminology sweep — after the 5.x rewrites land, audit all skills for "workload folder" / "active workload" usage that should now read "context folder" / "active context" (e.g. `report-plan`, `report-notes`, `report-changelog`, `context--files`, `workload` skill body, any remaining 5.x leftovers)
`workflowDeliver_implement` agent prompt — agent uses MCP instead of reading workload file
`workflowDeliver_refine` agent prompt — same change
Confirm spawned agents inherit MCP access (no extra prompts at spawn time)
Smoke-test: spawn a general-purpose agent that calls `mcp__swc-workload__list` to confirm hook accepts the call and no permission prompt fires at spawn time
`docs/plugin-design.md` — rename `workload.md` → `workload.json` in tree; note MCP ownership
`README.md` — update folder‑layout references; mention MCP dependency in install path
`skills/context--files/SKILL.md` — rename workload row in folder layout table, mark as MCP‑managed
`skills/skill--naming/SKILL.md` — drop examples referencing removed workload skills (if any)
Remove tests exercising `workload.py` rendering and markdown checkbox parsing
Decide MCP test strategy (mock vs real fixture) and document the choice
Add coverage for the new MCP‑backed touchpoints in at least one workflow skill
